Scoring formulas

Eurovision Games — exact scoring formulas

Every action maps to a transparent point total. This page lists the exact formulas the server uses to compute Top-5 and Worst-5 predictions, quiz answers, and duel outcomes — useful if you’re strategising before the show or arguing with the host afterwards.

01 · Quiz

Quiz scoring

Each quiz round is 10 questions, 4 options per question, 15-second timer. Points are tier-based on response time — fast and right pays the most.

Response timePoints (correct)
0–3 seconds12
3.01–7 seconds8
7.01–15 seconds4
Wrong / timeout0

Maximum quiz points per round: 10 questions × 12 = 120. Every night has 3 rounds, for a quiz cap of 360 points.

02 · Predictions

Top-5 prediction scoring

Each Top-5 pick is scored against the official combined jury + televote ranking:

ResultPoints
Country at the exact position you predicted50
Country in the official Top 5 but at a different position20
Country outside the Top 50

Maximum Top-5 points: 5 exact positions × 50 = 250.

Worst-5 prediction scoring

Symmetrical to Top-5, scored against the official bottom 5 (last-place country = position 1 in your Worst-5 list):

ResultPoints
Country at the exact bottom position you predicted50
Country in the official Worst 5 but at a different position20
Country outside the Worst 50

Maximum Worst-5 points: 250. Combined predictions cap: 500.

03 · Duels

Duel scoring

A duel is 3 trivia questions, head-to-head. Each correct answer scores by elapsed seconds — every second of hesitation costs you a point.

12 − sec

Whoever has the higher answer total wins the duel; if the totals are equal, the duel is a tie — no winner, and no points change hands. The winner’s answer total in that duel is their duel score; it is the base for Steal and Double below. There is no separate win bonus.

ScenarioPoints
Correct answer at 0–1 seconds11–12
Correct answer at 5 seconds7
Correct answer at 11 seconds1
Wrong / timeout (≥12s)0
Win bonus (none — the winner picks Steal or Double instead)0

Steal vs Double

The duel winner picks one of two effects on the points they just earned:

⚔️ Steal

Move your duel score from the loser’s banked total to yours. Capped at what the loser actually has — you cannot take them below zero — and unavailable if they have 0 points. Zero-sum swing: your gain matches their loss. Best when this opponent is the one you need to overtake.

✨ Double

Add 2 × your duel score to your own total. The loser keeps their points. Always the bigger gain for you — the natural pick when you’re racing the whole room rather than this one opponent, or when the loser has little or nothing banked.

Against that one opponent, both options open the same gap (2 × your duel score) as long as they have at least your duel score banked; against everyone else in the room, Double is worth twice as much. If the loser has 0 points, only Double is available.

04 · Edge cases

Penalties and edge cases

  • Quitting mid-game.

    Player marked away. Predictions still auto-score; quiz and duel opportunities are forfeited.

  • Refused duel challenges.

    No point penalty, but refusals are limited per player per night: 2 in rooms of up to 5 players, 3 with 6–10, 4 with 11–15, 5 with 16 or more. Refused rematches count too.

  • Mid-duel disconnect.

    Unanswered questions score 0; duel resolves on whoever has more points.

  • Cheating

    (multi-device, AI assist): the app can’t detect or undo it, so the room settles it by house rules.

  • Steal cap.

    You cannot drag the loser below zero — if they have less banked than your duel score, Steal only takes what’s there; if they have nothing, only Double is available.

Worked example

356points at the end of the night

You finished the night with:

  • Quiz.18 correct out of 30, mostly tier-2 timing → ~144 pts.~144
  • Predictions.1 exact Top-5 hit (50) + 2 in-Top-5 wrong-position (40) + 1 exact Worst-5 (50) + 1 in-Worst-5 (20) = 160 pts.160
  • Duels.Won 2, both Steal — duel scores of 28 and 24, and both opponents had at least that much banked, so 28 + 24 = 52 pts moved to you (there is no win bonus). Picking Double both times would have added 2 × (28 + 24) = 104 instead, with nothing taken from them.52
  • Total: 356 pts.(144 + 160 + 52) Likely Champion contender on a normal night.
